mechanism_narrative: A lower level of the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) indicates an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The correlation between FEDFUNDS and 20-day forward returns is not significantly negative (p>0.05) or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 5.0% indicates deteriorating labor market conditions that trigger risk-off sentiment, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: When UNRATE exceeds 5.0%, the average 5-day forward return is not significantly negative (t-test p>0.05) or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of rising monetary policy (FEDFUNDS > 4.5%) and a tightening labor market (UNRATE < 4.5%) signals an overheating economy that triggers a risk-off shift, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When FEDFUNDS > 4.5% and UNRATE < 4.5%, the average 20-day forward return is not significantly negative (t-test p>0.05) or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a housing recovery (HOUST > 1200), a high level of consumer spending (RSAFS > 380000) indicates strong demand that drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The average 60-day forward return when RSAFS > 380000 and HOUST > 1200 is not significantly positive (t-test p>0.05) or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the number of employed persons (PAYEMS) signals a strengthening labor market that boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The correlation between PAYEMS and 20-day forward returns is not significantly positive (p>0.05) or the Rank IC over any 3-year window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts (HOUST) below 1200 units signals a contraction in the housing sector that reduces consumer confidence and corporate investment, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: When HOUST < 1200, the average 5-day forward return is not significantly negative (t-test p>0.05) or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of rising industrial production (INDPRO > 110) and declining GDP (GDPC1 < 11700) indicates a supply shock during economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When INDPRO > 110 and GDPC1 < 11700, the average 20-day forward return is not significantly negative (t-test p>0.05) or the Rank IC over any 3-year window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a high-inflation regime (CPIAUCSL > 210), a rising federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS > 4.5%) signals aggressive monetary tightening that causes negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: When CPIAUCSL > 210 and FEDFUNDS > 4.5%, the average 60-day forward return is not significantly negative (t-test p>0.05) or the Rank IC over any 3-year window is below 0.03.
